description: This header file defines APIs for managing MLD Group objects in the COSA Data Model Library. It declares functions for retrieving and updating group entries, checking their state, and accessing parameter values.

methods.name: Entry_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of MLD group entries.

methods.name: Entry_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific MLD group entry by index.

methods.name: Entry_IsUpdated
methods.description: Checks if the specified MLD group entry has been updated.

methods.name: Entry_Synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the specified MLD group entry with the current state.

methods.name: Entry_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for a given MLD group entry.

methods.name: Entry_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value for a given MLD group entry.

methods.name: Entry_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG parameter value for a given MLD group entry.

methods.name: Entry_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for a given MLD group entry.
